Although world gold prices remained almost unchanged around $4,089/ounce, domestic prices continued to increase rapidly, widening the gap with world prices.Báo Lào Cai•27/06/2026Follow Vietnam.vn onGoogle News0Following the recovery on June 27th, the domestic gold market heated up again on the morning of June 28th. Most major brands such as SJC, DOJI , PNJ, Bao Tin Minh Chau, and Phu Quy adjusted sharply upwards in the SJC gold bar, gold ring, and 999.9 gold categories. Notably, the price of gold on the world market remained almost unchanged compared to the previous day. From $4,090 per ounce on June 27th, the price on the morning of June 28th was $4,089 per ounce, a slight decrease of $1 per ounce. However, the daily price range remained wide, from $3,983 to $4,098 per ounce, indicating that the international market has not yet escaped a state of significant volatility. Domestically, SJC gold has returned to the selling price range of 148.5 million VND/ounce. This is a fairly strong increase after the market recently experienced a series of rapid ups and downs due to global fluctuations, the US dollar, expectations of US interest rates, and the safe-haven sentiment of investors. Illustration Gold prices today, June 27th: SJC, BTMC, DOJI, PNJ increased in line with world gold prices. Gold prices today, June 27, 2026, surged at many major brands, with SJC gold returning to the 144-147 million VND/ounce range. World gold prices recovered to 4,090 USD/ounce, but the difference with domestic prices remains high. SJC gold price on June 28, 2026: increased by 1.5 million VND/ounce. At SJC Company, the price of gold bars in Ho Chi Minh City and the North is listed at 145.5 million VND/ounce for buying and 148.5 million VND/ounce for selling. Compared to June 27th, each ounce of gold has increased by 1.5 million VND in both buying and selling prices. With the new price, SJC gold has surpassed the 148 million VND/ounce selling price mark. The buy-sell spread remains at 3 million VND/ounce, meaning short-term gold buyers still need to carefully consider transaction costs. DOJI gold prices on June 28, 2026: gold bars and rings reached 148.5 million VND/ounce. At DOJI and SJC retail, Kim TT/AVPL and Hung Thinh Vuong 9999 gold rings are listed at 145.5 - 148.5 million VND/ounce. Compared to June 27th, these lines have increased by 1.5 million VND/ounce in both buying and selling prices. DOJI adjusted prices upwards across most products. The price of gold bars and 9999 gold rings increased faster than the sideways movement of world prices, indicating that the domestic market is reacting strongly to hoarding after a period of significant volatility. PNJ gold prices on June 28, 2026: gold bars and plain rings both reached 148.5 million VND/ounce. At PNJ, SJC 999.9 gold bars are listed at 145.5 - 148.5 million VND/ounce, an increase of 1.5 million VND/ounce compared to June 27th. PNJ 999.9 plain rings, Kim Bao gold, Phuc Loc Tai gold, and PNJ - Phuong Hoang gold are also priced at 145.5 - 148.5 million VND/ounce.
